##### Project general facts

Samana Imperial Garden is a stunning residential development that redefines modern living with a touch of nature’s elegance. The project offers studios and one and two-bedroom apartments with private pools, thoughtfully designed with flexible layouts that can easily adapt to your lifestyle. Every detail, from sunlit balconies to spacious interiors, is crafted to create a sense of harmony, comfort, and timeless sophistication.

Life at Samana Imperial Garden is enriched by a wide range of world-class amenities that bring leisure, wellness, and joy to every moment. Residents can relax in the hammock garden, enjoy open-air cinema nights, or host gatherings in beautifully designed party spaces. Fitness and wellness are seamlessly woven into daily life with outdoor yoga pavilions, steam and sauna rooms, indoor and outdoor gyms, and tranquil swimming pools for adults and children.

Every residence at Samana Imperial Garden features modern finishing with high-quality materials and fully equipped kitchens. Optional luxury German Murphy or Thomas Bed furniture allows residents to personalize their space with refined European craftsmanship. The thoughtfully designed living spaces create a private paradise where every moment feels elevated and life unfolds in its most beautiful form.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Arjan, a thriving and rapidly developing district in Dubai, this exceptional location is known for its well-planned layout, vibrant atmosphere, and proximity to some of the city's most famous attractions. Located between Al Barsha South and Dubai Motor City, it offers seamless connectivity to key highways, making travel across the emirate quick and convenient.

The location is distinguished by its blend of modern residential communities and abundant green spaces. Home to landmarks like Dubai Miracle Garden and Dubai Butterfly Garden, the district offers a unique combination of city living and natural beauty. With schools, healthcare facilities, retail outlets, and leisure options within easy reach, Arjan provides everything needed for a comfortable and self-sufficient lifestyle.

For those seeking a residence that embodies natural elegance, modern convenience, and a prime Dubai address, Arjan delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of strategic connectivity, green spaces, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most promising and desirable areas to live and invest in. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living — vibrant, connected and effortlessly refined.
